reason: Computed purely on the chronological 80% training split via TimeSeriesSplit. No exposure to the 20% test set or production period.
Selecting the model that performs best on the test set turns the test set into a validation set, leaking test distribution into selection (meta-leakage/test-set selection bias).
Does not use performance data to select, avoiding optimization bias, though it relies on the assumption that later training runs supersede earlier ones.
